newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa to make order announcement today.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to make order announcement today.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said it planned on Thursday to make an announcement in connection with potential orders for aircraft built by the U.S.'s McDonnell Douglas Corp.

"We are making a press announcement about this at 1600 hours local time in Farnborough (England)," a Lufthansa spokeswoman said by telephone, adding that she could give no further details before then.
The spokeswoman, who said she was referring to 1600 local time in Frankfurt, said the announcement was therefore scheduled to take place at 1500 BST/1400 GMT.

A Wall Street Journal article earlier on Thursday said McDonnell Douglas was close to an agreement with Lufthansa to sell up to 12 of its MD-11 cargo jets to the German carrier in a deal potentially worth $1.3 billion.
